record.reason: NRR-Core specifies contextual retention and non-resolution operators and tests one gated multi-vector embedding on a synthetic two-turn ambiguity task. The paper proposes non-collapsing attention as an implementation direction but does not evaluate long-context LLM memory, sparse attention, or serving costs.
record.title: NRR-Core: Non-Resolution Reasoning as a Computational Framework for Contextual Identity and Ambiguity Preservation
